audience: rota managers who plan shifts, cover and leave for staff in Rotageek

useCases.title: See who is on shift at a site
useCases.text: List the locations, then read the schedule of one location for a date-time window, with every user there.

useCases.title: Find open gaps in the rota
useCases.text: List the open gaps, which are unfilled shifts, for one or more locations between two date-times.

useCases.title: Review leave requests for a period
useCases.text: List the leave requests in a date range, with the leave types, to plan cover.

useCases.title: Book leave for a team member
useCases.text: Find the user and the leave type. Create a leave request with a start and end date-time. It can change the rota and the holiday balance.

useCases.title: Read a week's hours at a site
useCases.text: Read the scheduled and worked hours of each user at one location for the week that starts on a given date.
